title: Becket Settings
description: Configuration for a becket platform directory.

repos.description: Map of repository names to their configuration.

path.description: Relative path to the repository from the platform directory.

setup.description: Commands to run during first-time setup (executed in the repo worktree directory).

dev.description: Command to start the dev server (sent to a tmux window by 'becket dev').

env.description: Environment variables to set for setup and dev commands.

files.description: Files to copy into each workspace root. Paths are relative to the platform directory.

docker.description: Path to a docker-compose file, relative to the workspace root. Started by 'becket dev' and 'becket setup'.

session.description: Tmux session name for 'becket dev'. Defaults to the workspace ID.
